definitions.explanation: A warm, friendly feeling toward someone or something. The sense of closeness or approachability that makes someone feel comfortable.

examples.english: To feel a sense of familiarity.

examples.japanese: あの{先生|せんせい}は{親|した}しみやすい{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: That teacher is an approachable person.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{方言|ほうげん}を{聞|き}くと、{懐|なつ}かしさと{親|した}しみがこみ{上|あ}げてくる。
examples.english: When I hear the local dialect, nostalgia and a warm sense of familiarity well up inside me.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {親|した}しむ (to feel close to, to be familiar with). Describes a warm, approachable quality in people, places, or things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親|した}しみを{感|かん}じる: to feel familiarity/affection
- {親|した}しみを{込|こ}めて: with affection, affectionately
- {親|した}しみやすい: approachable, easy to feel close to
- {親|した}しみのある{笑顔|えがお}: a friendly smile
- {親|した}しみが{湧|わ}く: to feel warmth toward someone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愛着|あいちゃく}: attachment (deeper emotional bond, often to objects or places)
- {好意|こうい}: goodwill, favorable feeling (more formal; can imply romantic interest)
- {親近感|しんきんかん}: feeling of closeness (similar but slightly more formal; often used toward public figures)
